surat.headline: Surat cluster shows robust diamond demand and input-cost relief, tempered by textile fraud and fire disruptions.
what_changed: Surat diamond units shortened Diwali vacations from 25 days to just 7 days following a market surge.
Polyester FDY prices dropped 6.96% and staple fibre fell 4.33% due to declining crude and freight rates.
GJEPC reported a 96% surge in lab-grown diamond (LGD) exports and a 19% growth in natural diamond exports.
stress_signals: A broker in Mota Varachha allegedly defrauded a Katargam trader of 1,035.15 carats of polished diamonds worth Rs 1.27 crore [e8488d4182be].
Veer Creation operators fled with grey fabric, cheating Surat textile traders of Rs 43.54 lakh [e15e6b4c5b22].

Multiple fire incidents reported, including a textile factory fire in Sachin GIDC, a fire in a building housing textile units, and a textile godown fire lasting over 32 hours [386760347e06, 47888fb89bb1, 70735ded426a].
improvement_signals: IIT Gandhinagar and MANTRA signed an MoU, and Garden Silk Mills partnered with MANTRA for polymeric yarn development [1afe1286245d, a09df64b91a6].
Kira is tripling its lab-grown diamond output to 750,000 carats a month [e3a72bc7c6f3].
what_to_watch: Monitor inventory and asset insurance verification for textile units following recent fire incidents in godowns and industrial areas.
Track repayment behavior and counterparty verification processes among diamond traders and grey fabric operators to mitigate localized broker and trading fraud.
Observe the pricing pressure from rising lab-grown diamond output (such as Kira's expansion) on natural diamond resale values and margins [3d642383c7eb, e3a72bc7c6f3].
